title: Do Retrieval-Augmented Language Models Adapt to Varying User Needs?
authors: Peilin Wu; Xinlu Zhang; Wenhao Yu; Xingyu Liu; Xinya Du; Zhiyu Zoey Chen
why_relevant: Introduces an evaluation framework assessing RALMs across user-instruction modes (Context-Exclusive/First, Memory-First) under context matching, knowledge conflict, and irrelevant retrieval, directly addressing conflict resolution, instruction compliance, and robustness to noisy context.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on user-need adaptation rather than novel defenses; adversarial coverage is limited to counterfactual context.
